metric.label: Lexical baseline
metric.description: Character n-gram cosine distance. This is a reproducible lexical baseline, not a semantic or faithfulness score.

units.leftText: This is the word of the LORD that came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah:
units.rightText: The word of Jehovah which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.

units.leftText: “I will completely sweep away everything from the face of the earth,” declares the LORD.
units.rightText: I will utterly consume all things from off the face of the ground, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: “I will sweep away man and beast; I will sweep away the birds of the air, and the fish of the sea, and the idols with their wicked worshipers. I will cut off mankind from the face of the earth,” declares the LORD.
units.rightText: I will consume man and beast; I will consume the birds of the heavens, and the fishes of the sea, and the stumblingblocks with the wicked; and I will cut off man from off the face of the ground, saith Jehovah.
leftNotes: 1:3 Or and the idols that cause the wicked to stumble

units.leftText: “I will stretch out My hand against Judah and against all who dwell in Jerusalem. I will cut off from this place every remnant of Baal, the names of the idolatrous and pagan priests —
units.rightText: And I will stretch out my hand upon Judah, and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place, and the name of the Chemarim with the priests;

units.leftText: those who bow on the rooftops to worship the host of heaven, those who bow down and swear by the LORD but also swear by Milcom,
units.rightText: and them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops; and them that worship, that swear to Jehovah and swear by Malcam;
leftNotes: 1:5 Or by their king; Milcom is a variant of Molech; see Leviticus 18:21|LEV 18:21* and 1 Kings 11:7.

units.leftText: and those who turn back from following the LORD, neither seeking the LORD nor inquiring of Him.” The Day of the LORD (Malachi 4:1–6|MAL 4:1-6*; 1 Thessalonians 5:1–11|1TH 5:1-11*; 2 Peter 3:8–13|2PE 3:8-13*)
units.rightText: and them that are turned back from following Jehovah; and those that have not sought Jehovah, nor inquired after him.

units.leftText: Be silent in the presence of the Lord GOD, for the Day of the LORD is near. Indeed, the LORD has prepared a sacrifice; He has consecrated His guests.
units.rightText: Hold thy peace at the presence of the Lord Jehovah; for the day of Jehovah is at hand: for Jehovah hath prepared a sacrifice, he hath consecrated his guests.

units.leftText: “On the Day of the LORD’s sacrifice I will punish the princes, the sons of the king, and all who are dressed in foreign apparel.
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass in the day of Jehovah’s sacrifice, that I will punish the princes, and the king’s sons, and all such as are clothed with foreign apparel.

units.leftText: On that day I will punish all who leap over the threshold, who fill the house of their master with violence and deceit.
units.rightText: And in that day I will punish all those that leap over the threshold, that fill their master’s house with violence and deceit.
leftNotes: 1:9 Or the temple of their gods

units.leftText: On that day,” declares the LORD, “a cry will go up from the Fish Gate, a wail from the Second District, and a loud crashing from the hills.
units.rightText: And in that day, saith Jehovah, there shall be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, and a wailing from the second quarter, and a great crashing from the hills.
leftNotes: 1:10 Or the Second Quarter, a newer section of Jerusalem; Hebrew the Mishneh

units.leftText: Wail, O dwellers of the Hollow, for all your merchants will be silenced; all who weigh out silver will be cut off.
units.rightText: Wail, ye inhabitants of Maktesh; for all the people of Canaan are undone; all they that were laden with silver are cut off.
leftNotes: 1:11 Or the market district or the Mortar
1:11 Or all the people of Canaan

units.leftText: And at that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps and punish the men settled in complacency, who say to themselves, ‘The LORD will do nothing, either good or bad.’
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with lamps; and I will punish the men that are settled on their lees, that say in their heart, Jehovah will not do good, neither will he do evil.

units.leftText: Their wealth will be plundered and their houses laid waste. They will build houses but not inhabit them, and plant vineyards but never drink their wine.
units.rightText: And their wealth shall become a spoil, and their houses a desolation: yea, they shall build houses, but shall not inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, but shall not drink the wine thereof.

units.leftText: The great Day of the LORD is near — near and coming quickly. Listen, the Day of the LORD! Then the cry of the mighty will be bitter.
units.rightText: The great day of Jehovah is near, it is near and hasteth greatly, even the voice of the day of Jehovah; the mighty man crieth there bitterly.

units.leftText: That day will be a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of destruction and desolation, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness,
units.rightText: That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of wasteness and desolation, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness,

units.leftText: a day of horn blast and battle cry against the fortified cities, and against the high corner towers.
units.rightText: a day of the trumpet and alarm, against the fortified cities, and against the high battlements.

units.leftText: I will bring such distress on mankind that they will walk like the blind, because they have sinned against the LORD. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their flesh like dung.
units.rightText: And I will bring distress upon men, that they shall walk like blind men, because they have sinned against Jehovah; and their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as dung.

units.leftText: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them on the Day of the LORD’s wrath. The whole earth will be consumed by the fire of His jealousy.” For indeed, He will make a sudden end of all who dwell on the earth.
units.rightText: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of Jehovah’s wrath; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for he will make an end, yea, a terrible end, of all them that dwell in the land.
leftNotes: 1:18 Or of all the people living in the land

units.leftText: Gather yourselves, gather together, O shameful nation,
units.rightText: Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation that hath no shame;

units.leftText: before the decree takes effect and the day passes like chaff, before the burning anger of the LORD comes upon you, before the Day of the LORD’s anger comes upon you.
units.rightText: before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of Jehovah come upon you, before the day of Jehovah’s anger come upon you.

units.leftText: Seek the LORD, all you humble of the earth who carry out His justice. Seek righteousness; seek humility. Perhaps you will be sheltered on the day of the LORD’s anger. Judgment on the Philistines (Jeremiah 47:1–7|JER 47:1-7*)
units.rightText: Seek ye Jehovah, all ye meek of the earth, that have kept his ordinances; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye will be hid in the day of Jehovah’s anger.

units.leftText: For Gaza will be abandoned, and Ashkelon left in ruins. Ashdod will be driven out at noon, and Ekron will be uprooted.
units.rightText: For Gaza shall be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation; they shall drive out Ashdod at noonday, and Ekron shall be rooted up.

units.leftText: Woe to the dwellers of the seacoast, O nation of the Cherethites! The word of the LORD is against you, O Canaan, land of the Philistines: “I will destroy you, and no one will be left.”
units.rightText: Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea-coast, the nation of the Cherethites! The word of Jehovah is against you, O Canaan, the land of the Philistines; I will destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant.

units.leftText: So the seacoast will become a land of pastures, with wells for shepherds and folds for sheep.
units.rightText: And the sea-coast shall be pastures, with cottages for shepherds and folds for flocks.

units.leftText: The coast will belong to the remnant of the house of Judah; there they will find pasture. They will lie down in the evening among the houses of Ashkelon, for the LORD their God will attend to them and restore their captives. Judgment on Moab and Ammon (Isaiah 16:1–14|ISA 16:1-14*; Jeremiah 48:1–47|JER 48:1-47*)
units.rightText: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; they shall feed their flocks thereupon; in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening; for Jehovah their God will visit them, and bring back their captivity.

units.leftText: “I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the Ammonites, who have taunted My people and threatened their borders.
units.rightText: I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, wherewith they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.

units.leftText: Therefore, as surely as I live,” declares the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, “surely Moab will be like Sodom and the Ammonites like Gomorrah— a place of weeds and salt pits, a perpetual wasteland. The remnant of My people will plunder them; the remainder of My nation will dispossess them.”
units.rightText: Therefore as I live, saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, a possession of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation: the residue of my people shall make a prey of them, and the remnant of my nation shall inherit them.

units.leftText: This they shall have in return for their pride, for taunting and mocking the people of the LORD of Hosts.
units.rightText: This shall they have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of Jehovah of hosts.

units.leftText: The LORD will be terrifying to them when He starves all the gods of the earth. Then the nations of every shore will bow in worship to Him, each in its own place. Judgment on Cush and Assyria
units.rightText: Jehovah will be terrible unto them; for he will famish all the gods of the earth; and men shall worship him, every one from his place, even all the isles of the nations.

units.leftText: “You too, O Cushites, will be slain by My sword.”
units.rightText: Ye Ethiopians also, ye shall be slain by my sword.
leftNotes: 2:12 That is, people from the upper Nile region

units.leftText: And He will stretch out His hand against the north and destroy Assyria; He will make Nineveh a desolation, as dry as a desert.
units.rightText: And he will stretch out his hand against the north, and destroy Assyria, and will make Nineveh a desolation, and dry like the wilderness.

units.leftText: Herds will lie down in her midst, creatures of every kind. Both the desert owl and screech owl will roost atop her pillars. Their calls will sound from the window, but desolation will lie on the threshold, for He will expose the beams of cedar.
units.rightText: And herds shall lie down in the midst of her, all the beasts of the nations: both the pelican and the porcupine shall lodge in the capitals thereof; their voice shall sing in the windows; desolation shall be in the thresholds: for he hath laid bare the cedar-work.
leftNotes: 2:14 The precise identification of the animals rendered desert owl and screech owl is uncertain.

units.leftText: This carefree city that dwells securely, that thinks to herself: “I am it, and there is none besides me,” what a ruin she has become, a resting place for beasts. Everyone who passes by her hisses and shakes his fist.
units.rightText: This is the joyous city that dwelt carelessly, that said in her heart, I am, and there is none besides me: how is she become a desolation, a place for beasts to lie down in! every one that passeth by her shall hiss, and wag his hand.

units.leftText: Woe to the city of oppressors, rebellious and defiled!
units.rightText: Woe to her that is rebellious and polluted! to the oppressing city!

units.leftText: She heeded no voice; she accepted no correction. She does not trust in the LORD; she has not drawn near to her God.
units.rightText: She obeyed not the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in Jehovah; she drew not near to her God.

units.leftText: Her princes are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves, leaving nothing for the morning.
units.rightText: Her princes in the midst of her are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves; they leave nothing till the morrow.

units.leftText: Her prophets are reckless, faithless men. Her priests profane the sanctuary; they do violence to the law.
units.rightText: Her prophets are light and treacherous persons; her priests have profaned the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.

units.leftText: The LORD within her is righteous; He does no wrong. He applies His justice morning by morning; He does not fail at dawn, yet the unjust know no shame. Purification of the Nations
units.rightText: Jehovah in the midst of her is righteous; he will not do iniquity; every morning doth he bring his justice to light, he faileth not; but the unjust knoweth no shame.

units.leftText: “I have cut off the nations; their corner towers are destroyed. I have made their streets deserted with no one to pass through. Their cities are laid waste, with no man, no inhabitant.
units.rightText: I have cut off nations; their battlements are desolate; I have made their streets waste, so that none passeth by; their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, so that there is no inhabitant.

units.leftText: I said, ‘Surely you will fear Me and accept correction.’ Then her dwelling place would not be cut off despite all for which I punished her. But they rose early to corrupt all their deeds.
units.rightText: I said, Only fear thou me; receive correction; so her dwelling shall not be cut off, according to all that I have appointed concerning her: but they rose early and corrupted all their doings.

units.leftText: Therefore wait for Me,” declares the LORD, “until the day I rise to testify. For My decision is to gather nations, to assemble kingdoms, to pour out upon them My indignation — all My burning anger. For all the earth will be consumed by the fire of My jealousy. A Faithful Remnant
units.rightText: Therefore wait ye for me, saith Jehovah, until the day that I rise up to the prey; for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour upon them mine indignation, even all my fierce anger; for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.
leftNotes: 3:8 LXX and Syriac; Hebrew rise up to plunder

units.leftText: For then I will restore pure lips to the peoples, that all may call upon the name of the LORD and serve Him shoulder to shoulder.
units.rightText: For then will I turn to the peoples of a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of Jehovah, to serve him with one consent.

units.leftText: From beyond the rivers of Cush My worshipers, My scattered people, will bring Me an offering.
units.rightText: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants, even the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring mine offering.
leftNotes: 3:10 That is, the upper Nile region

units.leftText: On that day you will not be put to shame for any of the deeds by which you have transgressed against Me. For then I will remove from among you those who rejoice in their pride, and you will never again be haughty on My holy mountain.
units.rightText: In that day shalt thou not be put to shame for all thy doings, wherein thou hast transgressed against me; for then I will take away out of the midst of thee thy proudly exulting ones, and thou shalt no more be haughty in my holy mountain.

units.leftText: But I will leave within you a meek and humble people, and they will trust in the name of the LORD.
units.rightText: But I will leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people, and they shall take refuge in the name of Jehovah.

units.leftText: The remnant of Israel will no longer do wrong or speak lies, nor will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouths. But they will feed and lie down, with no one to make them tremble.” Israel’s Restoration
units.rightText: The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth; for they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make them afraid.

units.leftText: Sing for joy, O Daughter of Zion; shout aloud, O Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, O Daughter of Jerusalem!
units.rightText: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.

units.leftText: The LORD has taken away your punishment; He has turned back your enemy. Israel’s King, the LORD, is among you; no longer will you fear any harm.
units.rightText: Jehovah hath taken away thy judgments, he hath cast out thine enemy: the King of Israel, even Jehovah, is in the midst of thee; thou shalt not fear evil any more.

units.leftText: On that day they will say to Jerusalem: “Do not fear, O Zion; do not let your hands fall limp.
units.rightText: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not; O Zion, let not thy hands be slack.

units.leftText: The LORD your God is among you; He is mighty to save. He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you with His love; He will rejoice over you with singing.”
units.rightText: Jehovah thy God is in the midst of thee, a mighty one who will save; he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love; he will joy over thee with singing.
leftNotes: 3:17 Or He will be silent in His love; LXX and Syriac He will renew you with His love

units.leftText: “I will gather those among you who grieve over the appointed feasts, so that you will no longer suffer reproach.
units.rightText: I will gather them that sorrow for the solemn assembly, who were of thee; to whom the burden upon her was a reproach.

units.leftText: Behold, at that time, I will deal with all who afflict you. I will save the lame and gather the scattered; and I will appoint praise and fame for the disgraced throughout the earth.
units.rightText: Behold, at that time I will deal with all them that afflict thee; and I will save that which is lame, and gather that which was driven away; and I will make them a praise and a name, whose shame hath been in all the earth.

units.leftText: At that time I will bring you in; yes, at that time I will gather you. For I will give you fame and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your captives before your very eyes,” says the LORD.
units.rightText: At that time will I bring you in, and at that time will I gather you; for I will make you a name and a praise among all the peoples of the earth, when I bring back your captivity before your eyes, saith Jehovah.
